lessons.titleZh: 被擠到邊緣而少被重視

brief.meaningEn: Made less visible, influential or central in an activity, discussion or market; a local option can lose attention to a cheaper competitor without disappearing altogether.
brief.meaningZh: 在活動、討論或市場中變得較少被看見、較少影響力或較不受重視；本地選項可能因廉價競爭品而失去注意，卻未完全消失。
brief.grammar: Be pushed (quietly) to the margins, sidelines or side of a debate or programme. In a market-displacement context, be pushed aside by cheap or mass-produced goods. The metaphor describes lost prominence or attention, not literal physical movement; the by-phrase names a competing product.
brief.register: Figurative social or market description. A curator may tell colleagues that smaller art forms are pushed to the margins, or a craft seller may tell a fair organiser that local work is being pushed aside by cheap mass-produced goods.
brief.boundaryZh: 不一定完全被排除或實際移走；須有參與、注意、展示或選擇機會減少的證據。市場用法須清楚指出競爭商品，而非有人把物件推開。
brief.misconceptionZh: 仍在場不代表仍有實質參與；反過來，未採用一個建議也不單獨證明整個群體被邊緣化。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用發言、議程、展示或宣傳機會的具體變化描述被邊緣化。

listening.en: When the agenda gave almost all the time to large organisations, the small volunteer groups were pushed to the margins and had little chance to explain their needs.
listening.zh: 議程把幾乎全部時間給大機構時，小義工團體被擠到邊緣，少有機會解釋需要。
listening.promptZh: 小團體的主要困難是甚麼？

options.en: They chose to lead the discussion and set every agenda item.
options.zh: 它們選擇主導討論，訂定每項議程。

options.en: They attended but had little opportunity to make their needs heard.
options.zh: 它們出席，但少有機會讓需要被聽到。

options.en: They were the only groups given time to speak.
They rejected an equal speaking allocation because they wanted a shorter meeting.
options.zh: 它們因想縮短會議而拒絕平等發言分配。

listening.explanationZh: little chance to explain 提供實質參與減少的證據，不只是座位位置。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼小義工團體覺得難以參與這次討論？
reply.promptEn: Why did the small volunteer groups find it hard to participate?

options.en: They had very little speaking time.
The agenda gave their needs little attention.
options.zh: 議程很少注意它們的需要。

options.en: They were pushed to the margins of the discussion.
The larger organisations took nearly all the available time.
options.zh: 大機構佔去幾乎全部可用時間。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋參與機會少；金句用邊緣意象。

scene.promptZh: 手作市集仍讓本地工藝有攤位，但主展示區和大部分宣傳都給廉價大量生產商品，較少顧客留意手作。哪句最有根據？

options.en: Local crafts are being pushed aside by cheaper factory-made products in the fair’s displays and publicity.
options.zh: 在市集的展示和宣傳中，本地工藝正被較便宜的工廠製商品擠到一旁。

options.en: Because the local stalls are still open, their work has equal prominence in this fair.
options.zh: 本地攤位仍開放，所以它們的作品在這個市集得到同等重視。

options.en: This fair’s publicity proves that buyers for local crafts have disappeared from every nearby market.
options.zh: 這個市集的宣傳證明，附近每個市場都已沒有本地工藝的買家。

scene.explanationZh: 手作攤位仍在，但主展示和宣傳轉向廉價量產商品，支持本地工藝在這個市集失去能見度；仍有攤位不等於同等重視，也不能從一個市集推斷所有市場。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項資料最不足以單獨支持 pushed to the margins？

options.en: A group repeatedly receives little time to explain its needs.
options.zh: 一個團體反覆少有時間解釋需要。

options.en: A proposal is considered carefully but not chosen, while the group keeps an equal voice.
options.zh: 提案被仔細考慮後未獲選，但團體仍有平等發言權。

options.en: The agenda regularly leaves a group’s concerns unaddressed.
options.zh: 議程經常不處理某團體的關切。

contrast.explanationZh: 一次有理由未採納不單獨表示整體影響力被壓低。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「他們仍在會場，就不可能 pushed to the margins」。哪句回應最準確？

options.en: Let us use attendance alone to measure influence.
options.zh: 只用出席衡量影響力吧。

options.en: Being present does not rule out being pushed to the margins; check how much time or influence they actually have.
options.zh: 人在場仍可能被推到邊緣；要查他們實際有多少發言時間或影響力。

options.en: An invitation is enough evidence that their needs reached the agenda.
options.zh: 單憑邀請，已有足夠證據顯示他們的需要列入議程。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需要看發言、議程及影響，不只看有沒有到場。

speaking.en: Smaller groups should not be pushed to the margins of the discussion.
speaking.zh: 較小團體不應被擠到討論邊緣。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再表達實質參與的重要。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一部社區歷史短片反覆訪問知名訪客，卻很少呈現長期居民的經驗，居民覺得自己的故事不被看見。用一至兩句英文指出問題並建議補充訪談。

examples.en: Long-term residents are being pushed to the margins of the film while famous visitors receive most of the attention. We should include more local interviews.
examples.zh: 知名訪客獲大部分注意時，長期居民正被擠到短片邊緣。我們應加入更多本地訪談。

examples.en: The residents’ stories have been pushed to the margins, so the next edit should give their experiences a clearer place.
examples.zh: 居民故事被擠到邊緣，所以下次剪輯應讓他們的經驗更清楚呈現。

writing.selfCheckZh: 描述呈現與注意分配的證據，提出讓故事可見的改動，不只看居民有沒有到拍攝現場。

takeaways.en: Local concerns were pushed to the margins of the wider debate.
takeaways.zh: 本地關切被擠到較大辯論的邊緣。

takeaways.en: Mental wellbeing was pushed to the side when the planning meeting discussed only budgets and deadlines.
takeaways.zh: 規劃會議只談預算和期限，心理健康便被擱置一旁。
